{{Quote|We are gathered here to mourn our Emperor, His Imperial Majesty Roan Fel, embodiment of the Force, noble defender of the galaxy&hellip;|[[Hogrum Chalk]]|<ref name="War 6" />}}
Following his [[Death/Legends|death]] in the [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|final battle]] of the [[Second Imperial Civil War|war]] over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], a '''funeral''' was held planetside for former [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]]. [[Hogrum Chalk]], the emperor's brother-in-law, delivered Fel's eulogy while representatives of the [[Fel Empire]], the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] stood by in attendance. Despite having been working against Fel during the war, Chalk honored the late emperor by depicting him as a courageous hero who died in the struggle to liberate [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] from [[Darth Krayt]], the [[One Sith]] and [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|their Galactic Empire]]. For political reasons, Chalk left out the details about how Fel turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]]. Thus, he neglected to mention Fel's willingness to sacrifice the lives of the Empire's allies, including billions of innocent civilians, that were fighting against the Sith forces on Coruscant.<ref name="War 6" />

After commemorating Roan Fel's memory in his speech, Chalk also credited the former emperor with the results of the end of the war, specifically the formation of the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]]. [[Marasiah Fel]], Roan's only child and the first [[Emperor/Legends|Empress regnant]] of the Empire, joined [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] of the Galactic Alliance and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[K'Kruhk]] of the Jedi Order as the [[Triumvirate|triumvirs]] of the newly-established organization.<ref name="War 6" />
